rows.grounds: object of śṛṇu; prescribed ritual arrangement
indeclinable indicating conformity with prior instruction
qualifies vidhānaṃ as the entire procedure
locative compound indicating time or occasion: at the end of recitation
object of śṛṇu; supplication to be performed
imperative addressed to the listener requesting attention

items.question: What complete procedure and prayer must be performed at the end of recitation?
premises: The entire procedure is to be followed as before.
A prayer is to be made at the end of recitation.
The listener is commanded to hear this instruction.
items.inference: Therefore, at the end of recitation one must hear and follow the entire prior procedure together with the prescribed prayer.
items.plain_english: Hear the entire procedure as before, and the prayer at the end of recitation.
